note: Deep-dive #4. Stage deadline is 5 minutes so the escalation happens on camera: record escalated after the deadline. Use new invoice numbers for every take.
prepare: # owner signs in (device code), not recorded
$env:MG_TENANT = Read-Host 'Lab tenant short name (owner types)'; $env:PNP_CLIENT_ID = Read-Host 'PnP app client id (owner types)'

# manual: Invoices Inbox from episode 1 must exist (../01-enterprise-document-intelligence-ai-document-int/provision/New-InvoiceInbox.ps1); edit All Documents view: Name, Review status, Vendor, Total, Approval status, Approval step, Decided by, Approval summary

$m = az ad user list --filter "startswith(userPrincipalName,'sam.demo@')" --query '[0].userPrincipalName' -o tsv; $f = az ad user list --filter "startswith(userPrincipalName,'jordan.demo@')" --query '[0].userPrincipalName' -o tsv; $e = az ad user list --filter "startswith(userPrincipalName,'riley.demo@')" --query '[0].userPrincipalName' -o tsv
az group create -n rg-mglab-approvals -l westeurope -o none

az deployment group create -g rg-mglab-approvals -f infra/main.bicep -p infra/main.bicepparam -p managerEmail=$m financeEmail=$f escalationEmail=$e stageTimeoutMinutes=5 --query properties.outputs -o json > $env:TEMP\approvals-outputs.json

az role assignment create --role 'Key Vault Secrets Officer' --assignee (az ad signed-in-user show --query id -o tsv) --scope (az keyvault show -n $env:MG_KV04 --query id -o tsv) -o none; Start-Sleep -Seconds 90
az keyvault secret set --vault-name $env:MG_KV04 -n callback-signing-key --value ([Convert]::ToBase64String((1..48 | ForEach-Object { Get-Random -Maximum 256 }) -as [byte[]])) -o none
Push-Location src/InvoiceApproval; func azure functionapp publish $o.functionAppName.value; Pop-Location

# manual: flow 'Invoice approval relay' (create first), copy its trigger URL into Key Vault secret approval-flow-url (Set-Item/Read-Host, never on screen), then: az functionapp restart -g rg-mglab-approvals -n <functionAppName>
# manual: flow 'Invoice ready to approval queue' with Service Bus send via the flow-send rule connection string (off camera)
# manual: upload two PDFs as Alex and set Vendor/Invoice number/Total by hand (INV1001 1476 EUR, INV1002 7380 EUR; use INV1003/INV1004 for repeat takes); leave Approval status Not started

screens.name: library-waiting
steps: Open Invoices Inbox, All Documents with Name, Review status, Vendor, Total, Approval status, Approval step, Decided by, Approval summary
Set Review status = Ready on INV1001 and INV1002
Show Approval status 'Waiting for approval' and Approval step 'Manager approval: sam.demo@...' on both rows
mask: domain part of e-mail addresses (keep sam.demo readable)

screens.name: teams-approval
steps: Sign in as Sam Demo, open the Approvals app > Received
Approve INV1001 first so it appears as Approved by Sam
Open 'Invoice INV1002 from Fabrikam Ltd: 7380 EUR': details with the deadline, 'Open the invoice' link, Approve / Reject buttons
Fallback if Teams does not show it: Outlook on the web, the same actionable message in Sam's inbox

screens.name: escalated
steps: Leave INV1002 unanswered for more than 5 minutes (the Durable timer fires)
Refresh Invoices Inbox: INV1002 'Waiting for approval', step 'Manager approval escalated to riley.demo@...'; INV1001 Approved, Decided by sam.demo@...
Second capture: as Sam Demo approve the OLD request in Approvals, then open Outlook on the web (https://outlook.office.com): e-mail 'Invoice INV1002: your answer was not used'
mask: e-mail domains (keep riley.demo and sam.demo readable)

screens.name: outcome
steps: As Riley Demo approve the escalated manager stage, then as Jordan Demo approve the finance stage (7380 EUR is above the 5000 EUR threshold)
As labadmin refresh Invoices Inbox: INV1002 Approved, Decided by jordan.demo@..., Approval step empty
Show Approval summary: Manager: Approved by riley.demo@... (escalated); Finance: Approved by jordan.demo@...
Optional inset: Alex Demo's result e-mail in Outlook on the web
mask: e-mail domains (keep the user part readable)

teardown: az keyvault purge -n $env:MG_KV04 --location westeurope   # run once the group delete has finished
# manual: delete the 'Invoice approvals' solution (both flows) in DEV; keep the five library columns only if episode 5 needs them
